summary: Applied prepare-state preservation requirement for required-file preflight failures.

items.title: Preflight failure must preserve prepare-phase state
items.rationale: The spec now requires required-file preflight to run before prepare-state cleanup/deletion, requires preflight failure to preserve `--run-id` preparing state, and adds acceptance coverage for retry-critical preparing fields.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[2], overview.decisions[7], requirements R1/R4, acceptance_criteria R1/R4, and T-2 acceptance now cover preserving preparing state before worktree side effects.
